from funcy import rcurry, rpartial, get_spec

print("=== Testing rcurry with keyword-only args ===")

# Function with keyword-only arguments
@rcurry
def add_kwonly(a, b, *, c=10):
    return a + b + c

# Test curried calls
print(f"add_kwonly(1)(2) = {add_kwonly(1)(2)}")  # Should be 13 (c defaults to 10)
print(f"add_kwonly(1)(2)(c=5) = ???")
try:
    result = add_kwonly(1)(2)(c=5)
    print(f"  = {result}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"  Error: {e}")

# Actually for n=2, it should just be lambda x: lambda y: func(y, x)
# So add_kwonly(1)(2) should call func(2, 1) which is add_kwonly(2, 1, c=10) = 13
print(f"\nDirectly calling original: add_kwonly._func(2, 1, c=10) = {add_kwonly._func(2, 1, c=10)}")

print("\n=== Testing rpartial with keyword-only args ===")

def sub_kwonly(a, b, *, c=1):
    return a - b - c

p = rpartial(sub_kwonly, 10)
print(f"sub_kwonly(10, 3, c=1) via partial = {p(3, c=1)}")  # Should be 6
print(f"sub_kwonly(10, 3) via partial = {p(3)}")  # Should be 7 (c defaults to 1)

# Test passing kwargs through
p2 = rpartial(sub_kwonly, 10, c=5)
print(f"sub_kwonly(10, 3, c=5) via rpartial(partial_kwargs) = {p2(3)}")  # Should be 2

print("\n=== Testing get_spec ===")
print(f"get_spec(add_kwonly) = {get_spec(add_kwonly)}")
print(f"get_spec(sub_kwonly) = {get_spec(sub_kwonly)}")
print(f"get_spec(rpartial(sub_kwonly, 10)) = {get_spec(rpartial(sub_kwonly, 10))}")
EOF
